title: Object Storage: exit
content:
Object Storage exit is governed by the following clauses.

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources. An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge. For active or suspended contracts, record closed date from the current handling clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time. Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits. termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis. If a signed commitment remains unexpired and commitment cancel allowed is false, invoice its recorded remaining commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability. No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible. Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect. Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains. A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

For customer disposal, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, customer request reference, original source reference. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference together with customer request reference together with original source reference for the proposed action. The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.
